news.title: 2026 Kubernetes and Cilium Networking Predictions
news.summary: 该文章为对2026年Kubernetes与Cilium网络方向的预测性内容。Cilium是基于eBPF/XDP构建的容器网络数据面，其发展轨迹直接关联Linux内核网络能力（如eBPF程序、kube-proxy替代、service mesh数据面卸载）。预测类文章通常涉及CNI演进、eBPF在内核中的进一步落地、与传统iptables/IPVS的对比取舍、以及在多集群、零信任场景下的网络策略实施方向。由于仅提供标题未含具体技术细节（如新增eBPF hook、性能基准、API变化），无法判断其技术深度，但Cilium作为Linux内核eBPF生态最重要的容器网络落地项目，其方向性预测值得eBPF/netdev社区跟踪者关注。

news.title: LWN.net Weekly Edition for August 27, 2026
news.abstract: Welcome to the LWN.net Weekly Edition for August 27, 2026 This edition contains the following feature content: An ongoing 3D-printer AGPL violation : what is being done to try to provide users of Bambu Lab 3D-printer software with alternatives. Considering the OpenMDW license : a license for distributing LLMs and related materials seems unlikely to gain OSI approval in its current form. How to be safe from quantum computing : a look at configuration changes and protocol updates needed to protect today's encrypted data from tomorrow's quantum computers. The beginning of the 7.3 merge window : some of the noteworthy changes coming to the next kernel release. Old-school calendaring at the command line with Remind : a look at a calendaring system older than Linux. A look at the Quickshell desktop-component toolkit : the project behind popular desktop shells for minimal window managers. This week's edition also includes these inner pages: Brief items : Brief news items from throughout the community. Announcements : Newsletters, conferences, security updates, patches, and more. news.summary: 该期汇编涵盖AGPL开源许可争议、量子计算带来的协议升级，以及Linux 7.3合并窗口概览等主题。所给内容未具体展开网络子系统、eBPF/XDP、NIC驱动、容器网络数据面或RDMA/DPDK变更，也未提供性能测试、方法或评估结论。因此无法判断其对Linux网络栈及高速网络路径的实际影响，筛选价值主要在通用内核和协议演进。
